notes: Strip e: x 6480-8030 plus ~300 px overlap (6180-8330). Plate is rotated ~3 deg, so the 'vertical' streets (Sulser, Elvira, Corning, Harlem) drift east going down the plate. Streets: Jonathan Avenue (printed JONATHAN; suffix not seen in this strip), Brewster Avenue (BREWSTER, AVE. east of strip), Corning Avenue (CORNING AVE.), Elvira Street, Sulser Street, Pleasant View Avenue, Harlem Place (HARLEM ... PL.), Blair Avenue (BLAIR, AVE. printed at x~9000), Ruth (printed RUTH, no suffix seen; recorded as Ruth Avenue), St. Leger Place (ST. LEGER ... PL.), Dixmont Avenue (DIXMONT ... AVE.), Gilbert Avenue. Ruth, Blair, St. Leger and Dixmont run east to Woodburn Avenue (x~8650) and Gilbert, outside this strip. Dixmont rejoins Gilbert at about (8420, 4840), outside the overlap, not picked. Billings Street (x~6085) and its T with Jonathan (~6030, 1830) lie west of the overlap, not picked. Gilbert's south side is cut by the plate edge (the outline follows Gilbert's south line, with small tabs at street openings); its centre was taken midway between the block line and the plate edge, close to the car tracks. A narrow unnamed strip (three parallel lines, '134.42'') runs west-south-west from Ruth's west end across the Jos. Greenham estate to x~6780; not a named street, not recorded. 'Woodburn Heights', 'Idlewild', 'Jonathan Lyon's Est.', 'Greenham's Est.' are subdivision/estate labels, not streets.
